description:
Bennett is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

An orphan discovered by an elderly adventurer in the Mare Jivari as a baby, Bennett was raised far from his native Natlan in Mondstadt 's Adventurers' Guild . He is the one and only member of " Benny's Adventure Team ," as everyone else left the team after experiencing the constant misfortune that follows him.
role_summary: Bennett is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Strike of Fortune
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 rapid strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Passion Overload
talents.description: Bennett puts all his fire and passion for adventuring into his sword. Results may vary based on how fired up he is... (‍ Press Text for mouse and keyboard and controller ‍/‍ Tap Text for touch screen ‍) A single, swift flame strike that deals Pyro DMG . Hold (Short) Charges up, resulting in different effects when unleashed based on the Charge Level.

talents.name: Fantastic Voyage
talents.description: Bennett performs a jumping attack that deals Pyro DMG , creating an Inspiration Field. Inspiration Field If the health of a character within the AoE is equal to or falls below 70%, their health will continuously regenerate. The amount of HP restored scales off Bennett's Max HP. If the health of a character within the AoE is higher than 70%, they gain an ATK Bonus that is based on Bennett's Base ATK. Imbues characters within the AoE with Pyro .

talents.name: Fearnaught
talents.description: When inside Fantastic Voyage 's circle, Passion Overload 's CD is decreased by 50% and Bennett cannot be launched by this skill's explosion.

talents.name: It Should Be Safe...
talents.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt , time consumed is reduced by 25%.

c1.name: Grand Expectation
c1.effect: Fantastic Voyage 's ATK increase no longer has an HP restriction, and gains an additional 20% of Bennett's Base ATK.

c2.name: Impasse Conqueror
c2.effect: When Bennett's HP falls below 70%, his Energy Recharge is increased by 30%.

c3.name: Unstoppable Fervor
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Passion Overload by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Unexpected Odyssey
c4.effect: Description Advanced Properties Preview Using a Normal Attack as the second attack of Passion Overload 's Charge

c5.name: True Explorer
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Fantastic Voyage by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Fire Ventures With Me
c6.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters inside Fantastic Voyage 's radius gain a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus and their weapons are infused with Pyro . Bennett's Pyro infusion will override Chongyun 's Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost , Keqing 's Stellar Restoration from her 1st Passive Talent , and Kamisato Ayaka 's Cryo infusion from Kamisato Art: Senho . (See Overriding Infusions for details) Although the description specifies that the 15% Pyro DMG buff only applies to Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters, the buff instead applies to any and all character inside Fantastic Voyage's radius, regardless of their wielded weapon. The infusion, however, only applies to Sword-, Claymore- and Polearm-wielding characters as stated.
